versions.name: Horsemanship
versions.description: Groom, saddle, bridle, and lead a horse safely, know its parts, breeds, feed, and hoof care, spot colic and lameness, then ride at walk and trot through turns, halts, and backing up.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
